# dsh-system1
**Connect to multiple decision providers and models through one interface: Jev via TypeSafe, Clef vi
a Cloudflare, Drex via Nace, Decider 1 via meraGPT, self-hosted Laya, and compatible custom provider
s.** Agents and plugins can classify content, filter candidates, score against criteria, or locate o
bjects in images, then use structured results in their own workflows. Requests can include text, ima
ges, audio, and video where the provider and model support them. The agent can call the built-in `sy
stem1_decide` tool, and plugins can use the same service through `ctx.system1.decide()`.
[](https://github.com/exoticknight/dsh-system1/actions/workflows/check.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.com

## Providers and models
Choose a built-in provider or add one that implements the public provider contract. Model options an
d supported inputs vary by provider and model.
| Provider | Model options | Deployment and notable support |
| TypeSafe (`typesafe`) | `jev-latest`, `jev-preview`, `jev-1.14.0`, `jev-1.13.0` | Hosted Jev; PNG/

JPEG; `box` requires `jev-1.14.0` or `jev-preview`; optional 262k context. |
| Cloudflare (`cloudfla
re`) | `clef`, `clef-flash`, `clef-omni` | Workers AI or a compatible local Clef service; PNG/JPEG/W

ebP; `clef-omni` also accepts audio and video. |
| Nace.AI (`nace`) | `drex-v2.0`, `drex-v1.5`, `dre
x-max`, `drex-max-v1.1`, `drex-max-finance` | Hosted Drex; all three Max models accept images, up to
512 questions and 255 choice/score options. Original Max selects from state up to 524k tokens, allo
ws 262k per question and caps combined long questions at 1,048,576; v1.1 and Finance cap the whole r

equest at 262k; Finance specializes in financial decisions. |
| meraGPT (`meragpt`) | `decider-1` (`
sd-1`, `state-decider-1`) | Hosted Decider 1; 4k-token whole-request context, up to 64 questions and

10 choice/score options. Uses prepaid API credit. |
| Laya (`laya`) | `auto`, `english`, `multiling

ual`, `typed-decisions` | Self-hosted Laya server; text only; API key optional. |
| Custom | — | Any
backend implementing the public provider contract. |
See provider setup for credentials, endpoints, and full capability limits.
System One models are decision models that return typed answers with probabilities instead of genera
ted text. The name borrows Kahneman's "fast thinking": they handle narrow judgments such as gating,
routing, and scoring, while the main LLM writes and reasons.
| Primitive | Result                                                               |

| `noul`    | Yes/no: probability that the proposition is true (`probabilityTrue`) |
| `choice`  | C

andidate key and the full probability distribution                  |
| `score`   | Expected zero-ba

sed level and the probability distribution           |
| `box`     | Normalized image coordinates fo
r a located object (model-dependent)  |

## Install from npm
Install the package in a project that uses System One:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
To activate the bundled service and providers in dsh, add the npm package to the profile you run. Re
place `<profile>` with your profile name:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The dsh plugin command requires a profile; installing into one profile does not activate the bundle
in other profiles. To use the GitHub repository as the package source, replace `dsh-system1` in that
command with `github:exoticknight/dsh-system1`.
The bundled patch mounts the service and built-in providers. The service defaults to model `jev-late
st` on provider `typesafe`. Each attempt uses a request-level `timeoutMs` when supplied, then that p
rovider's configured timeout or its own default: 800 ms for TypeSafe, Laya, and Cloudflare; 60,000 m
s for Nace. Set a provider timeout in that provider's settings page. Use plugin settings to choose t
he service and model, add fallbacks in order, configure connections, and store keys in DSH credentia
ls; environment variables are also supported. Each fallback gets the full timeout budget, so total r
equest time can grow with the chain length. Adjust the selected provider's `timeoutMs` for backend l
atency, especially local CPU inference.
## Update notices
The first load of a new plugin release in DSH Web automatically shows an update summary. Select **Re
lease notes** in the System One plugin settings to read it again. The summary ships with the plugin
and works offline; the full release notes link requires a connection.
The current browser stores only the last shown notice ID for the current DSH origin. Refreshing or r
estarting does not repeat the notice; clearing site data, switching browsers, or downgrading and upg
rading again may show it again. If browser storage or cross-tab coordination is unavailable, automat
ic notices are skipped and manual viewing remains available.
## Agent tool
Once installed, the agent can call the `system1_decide` tool without a consumer plugin. The main mod
el can hand yes/no checks, classification, and scoring to System One and decide the next step from t
he returned probabilities. The tool uses the default service and model configured above.
The bundle's `system1-tool` component provides the tool and is enabled by default. Turn the componen
t off on the Plugins page to remove the tool, or set `disabled: true` on its entry in a headless pro
file. See the API reference for arguments and results.
